glock.name: Glock 19
glock.desc: Quick aimed shots. Reliable single-target damage.

ak.name: AK-47
ak.desc: Rapid fire with a little spread.

sword.name: Moon Sword
sword.desc: Sweeping blade cuts through nearby enemies.

axe.name: Boomerang Axe
axe.desc: Spinning axes fly out and return to you.

trail.name: Ember Trail
trail.desc: Leave burning ground behind as you move.

frost.name: Frost Orbit
frost.desc: Orbiting ice shards damage and slow enemies.

mine.name: Pulse Mine
mine.desc: Drop mines that explode when enemies approach.

armor.name: Iron Bark
armor.desc: Reduce incoming damage by 8% per level.

heart.name: Heart Seed
heart.desc: +15 maximum health per level. Heal 15 on purchase.

magnet.name: Gravity Charm
magnet.desc: Greatly expand your material pickup radius.

lens.name: Predator Lens
lens.desc: +8% critical chance per level. Critical hits deal double damage.

regen.name: Moss Bandage
regen.desc: Regenerate 0.5 health per second per level.

fang.name: Blood Fang
fang.desc: Heal 0.4 health per level whenever you defeat an enemy.

dragon.name: Dragon Carbine
dragon.desc: Explosive automatic rounds with burning blasts.

reaper.name: Reaper Wheel
reaper.desc: Huge returning blades, with a close-range slash.

comet.name: Comet Wake
comet.desc: Wide frostfire trails burn and slow pursuing enemies.

tesla.name: Tesla Halo
tesla.desc: An electric halo with long lightning chains.

guardian.name: Guardian Edge
guardian.desc: A wide sweeping blade that also reduces damage by 20%.

vampire.name: Vampire Trigger
vampire.desc: Piercing bullets heal you when they hit.

nova.name: Nova Engine
nova.desc: Huge proximity mines plus an explosive ring.

shotgun.name: Scatter Cannon
shotgun.desc: A wide fan of pellets. Devastating up close.

spear.name: Sun Spear
spear.desc: Long-range piercing bolts hit enemies in a line.

saw.name: Sawblade Swarm
saw.desc: Orbiting metal blades shred nearby enemies.

rocket.name: Rocket Tube
rocket.desc: Slow explosive rockets with a large blast radius.

meteor.name: Meteor Wand
meteor.desc: Call an area blast onto the nearest enemy.

thorns.name: Thorn Crown
thorns.desc: Deal 15 damage per level to enemies touching you.

shield.name: Aegis Core
shield.desc: Block one hit every 12 seconds. Each level lowers cooldown by 1 second.

coin.name: Lucky Coin
coin.desc: +10% materials from enemy drops per level.

novaSkill.name: Frostburst
novaSkill.desc: Press E or tap SKILL: damage and slow enemies in a wide ring. 10s cooldown.

healSkill.name: Second Wind
healSkill.desc: Press E or tap SKILL: heal 15 HP per level. 14s cooldown.

stormSkill.name: Thunder Surge
stormSkill.desc: Press E or tap SKILL: burst every enemy within 450 range. 12s cooldown.

furySkill.name: Battle Fury
furySkill.desc: E / SKILL: +50% damage and attack speed for 4 seconds, plus 0.5 seconds per level. 16s cooldown.

phaseSkill.name: Phase Veil
phaseSkill.desc: E / SKILL: become invulnerable for 1.5 seconds, plus 0.3 seconds per level. 18s cooldown.

barrageSkill.name: Star Barrage
barrageSkill.desc: E / SKILL: unleash a radial burst of piercing stars. More stars and damage each level. 9s cooldown.

gravitySkill.name: Gravity Well
gravitySkill.desc: E / SKILL: pull nearby enemies toward a point ahead of you, then detonate and slow them. 13s cooldown.

renewalSkill.name: Renewal Field
renewalSkill.desc: E / SKILL: regenerate 5 HP per level each second for 4 seconds. 20s cooldown.

frostTrail.name: Frost Trail
frostTrail.desc: Leave ice behind you. Damages and slows enemies crossing it.

acidTrail.name: Acid Trail
acidTrail.desc: Corrosive puddles make enemies take 20% more damage while exposed.

sparkTrail.name: Lightning Trail
sparkTrail.desc: Charged ground zaps nearby enemies in addition to direct damage.

spreader.name: Trail Spreader
spreader.desc: +15% radius to all trail weapons per level.

catalyst.name: Trail Catalyst
catalyst.desc: +12% damage to all trail weapons per level.

linger.name: Everlasting Soles
linger.desc: Trail patches linger 0.5 seconds longer per level.

frostfire.name: Frostfire River
frostfire.desc: Ember + Frost Trail: a wide burning river that also slows enemies.

toxicstorm.name: Toxic Storm Trail
toxicstorm.desc: Acid + Lightning Trail: corrosive ground with electric arcs.

worldtrail.name: Cataclysm Trail
worldtrail.desc: Frostfire River + Toxic Storm Trail: an enormous four-element wake. Burns, slows, corrodes, and arcs lightning.

rail.name: Rail Rifle
rail.desc: Fast piercing rounds punch through crowds.

chakram.name: Chakram
chakram.desc: Rapid returning discs cut through pursuing enemies.

stormscatter.name: Stormscatter
stormscatter.desc: Scatter Cannon + Storm Coil: pellet fans and chained lightning.

sunfall.name: Sunfall Launcher
sunfall.desc: Rocket Tube + Meteor Wand: explosive rockets and targeted meteor blasts.

razorhalo.name: Razor Halo
razorhalo.desc: Sawblade Swarm + Chakram: orbiting saws and returning discs.

thunderlance.name: Thunder Lance
thunderlance.desc: Rail Rifle + Sun Spear: rapid, heavy piercing bolts.

bloodmoon.name: Bloodmoon Blades
bloodmoon.desc: Chakram + Blood Fang: sweeping returning blades. Heal 0.8 HP per kill per level.

starforge.name: Starforge
starforge.desc: Sunfall Launcher + Stormscatter: meteors, explosive rounds, and chain lightning.

wintercrown.name: Winter Crown
wintercrown.desc: Frost Orbit + Thorn Crown: a freezing orbit and sweeping close-range blade.

bastion.name: Living Bastion
bastion.desc: 40% damage reduction and +75 max HP. Each upgrade adds 8% and 15 HP.

bloodroot.name: Bloodroot Relic
bloodroot.desc: 2.5 HP/s regeneration and 2 HP per kill. Upgrades add 0.5 HP/s and 0.4 HP per kill.

reactor.name: Overclock Reactor
reactor.desc: +50% attack speed and 40% faster ability recharge. Upgrades add 10% and 8%.

waroracle.name: War Oracle
waroracle.desc: +60% damage and 40% critical chance. Upgrades add 12% and 8%.

pathcore.name: Trail Nexus
pathcore.desc: +75% trail radius and +60% trail damage. Upgrades add 15% and 12%.

scavenger.name: Scavenger Engine
scavenger.desc: +40% movement speed and +50% materials. Upgrades add 8% and 10%.

worldheart.name: Worldheart
worldheart.desc: Living Bastion + Bloodroot Relic: all four defensive bonuses in one slot. Upgrades strengthen each bonus.

flameplate.name: Flaming Chestplate
flameplate.desc: Ember Trail + Iron Bark: 40% damage reduction and a burning aura. Each level adds 8% reduction, aura size, and damage. Uses one item slot.

frostmantle.name: Froststep Mantle
frostmantle.desc: Frost Trail + Wind Boots: +40% movement speed and an icy aura that slows enemies. Upgrades grow the aura, damage, and movement bonus. Uses one item slot.

stormcap.name: Storm Capacitor
stormcap.desc: Storm Coil + Arc Battery: 40% faster ability recharge and automatic chain lightning. Upgrades strengthen both effects. Uses one item slot.

bloodsaw.name: Bloodsaw
bloodsaw.desc: Orbiting saws and sweeping cuts; heal 2 HP per kill at level 1. Upgrades strengthen the attack and item bonus. Uses one weapon slot.

siegebreaker.name: Siege Breaker
siegebreaker.desc: Pellet fans plus explosive rounds; +60% damage to all attacks at level 1. Upgrades strengthen the attack and item bonus. Uses one weapon slot.

oraclerail.name: Oracle Rail
oraclerail.desc: Piercing shots and chain lightning; +40% critical chance at level 1. Upgrades strengthen the attack and item bonus. Uses one weapon slot.

bastionmines.name: Bastion Mines
bastionmines.desc: Heavy proximity explosions; 40% damage reduction at level 1. Upgrades strengthen the attack and item bonus. Uses one weapon slot.

blastheart.name: Blastheart Harness
blastheart.desc: Burning pulses and explosive shots; +75 max HP at level 1. Upgrades strengthen the attack and item bonus. Uses one item slot.

renewaltotem.desc: Automatic meteor strikes; regenerate 2.5 HP/s at level 1. Upgrades strengthen the attack and item bonus. Uses one item slot.

plagueweave.name: Plagueweave Cloak
plagueweave.desc: Leaves corrosive ground; regenerate 2.5 HP/s at level 1. Upgrades strengthen the attack and item bonus. Uses one item slot.

fortunedynamo.name: Fortune Dynamo
fortunedynamo.desc: Automatic chain lightning; +50% materials at level 1. Upgrades strengthen the attack and item bonus. Uses one item slot.

smg.name: Vector SMG
smg.desc: Three-shot automatic bursts. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

minigun.name: Minigun
minigun.desc: Four-round sprays with a very short cooldown. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

crossbow.name: Repeater Crossbow
crossbow.desc: A tight fan of piercing bolts. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

kunai.name: Shadow Kunai
kunai.desc: Five knives spread out to catch flanking enemies. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

laser.name: Laser Lance
laser.desc: A long beam instantly hits every enemy in its path. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

prism.name: Prism Ray
prism.desc: A wide, shorter beam that slows its targets. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

flamer.name: Flamethrower
flamer.desc: Rapid fire cones scorch enemies ahead of you. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

icebreath.name: Cryo Sprayer
icebreath.desc: A broad frost cone damages and slows crowds. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

hammer.name: Earthshaker Hammer
hammer.desc: Heavy ground slams strike every nearby enemy. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

bell.name: Frost Bell
bell.desc: Wide freezing pulses hold off surrounding enemies. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

star.name: Star Disc
star.desc: Piercing stars fly in every direction. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

cactus.name: Cactus Cannon
cactus.desc: A dense ring of needles clears space around you. Damage and attack speed increase with upgrades.

bulletstorm.name: Bulletstorm
bulletstorm.desc: Vector SMG + Minigun: an amplified piercing bullet barrage.

nightvolley.name: Night Volley
nightvolley.desc: Repeater Crossbow + Shadow Kunai: an amplified fan of piercing blades.

eclipseray.name: Eclipse Ray
eclipseray.desc: Laser Lance + Prism Ray: an amplified wide freezing beam.

thermalbreath.name: Thermal Dragon
thermalbreath.desc: Flamethrower + Cryo Sprayer: an amplified long frostfire cone.

glacierquake.name: Glacierquake
glacierquake.desc: Earthshaker Hammer + Frost Bell: an amplified massive freezing ground slam.

supernova.name: Supernova Disc
supernova.desc: Star Disc + Cactus Cannon: an amplified all-direction star barrage.

salvagegloves.name: Salvager Gloves
salvagegloves.desc: +90 material pickup range at level 1, then +18 per upgrade. Stacks with Gravity Charm.
